lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, with higher density observed in the upper lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light networks from surface refraction are visible across the dorsal silhouette and caudal peduncle.
